scope: Opt-in v1 project/image/draft/criteria confirmation backend and local file publication/reconciliation; no review execution, new UI, GC/import/backup or production rollout
dependency_scope: Direct versions pinned; this macOS resolver install is not an all-platform transitive lock or security audit

hash_vectors.serialization_only_binary64_edge: HASH-11; API still rejects unsafe integers

checks_passed: Current authenticated user creates project + active owner + audit atomically; owner-only archive/restore; viewer/editor and foreign-project boundaries
Bounded strict JSON, decimal BIGINT revision, no-op PUT preserves actor/time; stale revision and revision exhaustion rejected
Actual PNG/JPEG/WEBP decoding, static-only/pixel/byte bounds, EXIF once, white alpha composite, raw original preservation and independent display PNG
Actual streamed multipart cap even with misleading Content-Length; extra fields/files rejected; parser temporary files closed on all exits
UUID storage keys, dir-fd root anchoring and NOFOLLOW, root replacement/symlink/hardlink/FIFO/tamper/missing rejection, final collisions never overwrite
Actual filesystem fsync/no-clobber and independent subprocess lock probes; same-root second service rejected
File publication and image normalization run with zero checked-out DB connections; shared gate then short DB transaction and final rights/archive/session recheck
Synthetic mid-graph DB division-by-zero rolls all business references back while finalized bytes remain preserved
Actual DB commit followed by injected lost acknowledgement restores success using fresh primary graph/intent checks; no-commit/unresolved outcomes preserve bytes
Actual PostgreSQL operation advisory try-lock busy -> unresolved; mismatched intent -> conflict; no absence inference while another operation transaction owns lock
Actual independent process abrupt exit after first payload / before BEGIN; startup identifies not_committed and preserves bytes without GC
Same actor/key concurrent confirm returns one UUID/one sealed graph; distinct keys issue project numbers 1/2 with equal content hashes
Replay survives edits/archive/restart but still requires current editor/owner; same actor/key across projects conflicts; other actors have independent keys
Criteria hash and draft hash recomputed from persisted source; selected source_item preserved, missing rule/expected/source metadata remain SQL NULL
Real HTTP/Uvicorn upload-confirm-restart-replay with app-only environment, content/session persisted, no secrets in child logs
C01-C08 offline/DB regression including M007 guards/M008 ACLs and C08 live process test retained
Daily public schema/OIDs/default privileges unchanged; all random temporary DBs cleaned; no daily migration or account seed
known_limits: No C10 review/OCR routes or execution
No C13 independent worker or remote submit recovery
No C14 GC/quarantine/import/backup restore or disk exhaustion benchmark
No Linux/Windows production storage or power failure certification; one local host/one app process only
